name: @ismail-elkorchi/textsearch
description: Search analyzers, indexes, query languages, ranking, filtering, faceting, highlighting, and suggestions runtime package.

scripts.clean: node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs dist && node scripts/clean-build-output.mjs dist-test
scripts.lint: biome check src test scripts docs README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json --files-ignore-unknown=true
scripts.test:node: npm run build && node --test test/suite.test.ts test/public-api.test.ts test/types/public-api.test.ts test/runtime/node.test.ts
scripts.test:deno: npm run build && deno test --no-lock --no-check --allow-read test/runtime/deno.test.ts
scripts.test:bun: npm run build && if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun test test/runtime/bun.test.ts; elif [ -n "$CI" ]; then echo 'error: bun is required in CI' >&2; exit 1; else echo 'skip: bun not installed'; fi
scripts.test:all: npm run test:node && npm run test:deno && npm run test:bun && npm run test:browser && npm run test:workers && npm run check:pack
